Absolutely no background, margin, cast shadow, surrounding objects or perspective. Every pixel is wrapper material. Soft flexible metallic foil with convincing creases and heat-sealed ridges, not a rigid box or book.
Reference image: existing wrapper is a reference for physical proportions, flexible foil, and polish only. Create a visibly NEW bespoke package design, not a hue change or copy of its architecture.
Production composition: top crimp occupies 0–6% height; relatively quiet tear strip down to 13.5% height; a straight tear seam across the width at exactly 13.5%. A small horizontal EMPTY name plaque centered at x=22–78%, y=73–81%. The label will be live UI text. NO WORDS, NO LETTERING, NO LOGO, NO FAKE RUNIC TEXT anywhere. Ornamental abstract linework is fine. Keep detailed material visible behind branding, and rich readable decoration outside it.
